correctness.rationale: The Steffen tangent map is continuous, coordinatewise nondecreasing, and almost-everywhere partially differentiable with each partial in [0,2]. The Hermite derivative basis has center cone A+aB+bC nonnegative and exactly integrating to one for a,b in [0,2], while the neighbor basis variation is exactly 8/27. This proves the all-input weighted column bound; telescoping or path integration and BV truncation extend to all finite-variation data. For any chosen cell, positive neighboring secants can be made large enough to activate both 2*s_center branches, achieving the coefficient exactly. The algebraic checker verifies all cornerstone polynomial identities and a rational 107/27 witness; finite experiments are not used as infinite proof.
